audioReview.note: Author confirmed listening to the complete final set using the transcripts and answer checks, and approved all twelve recordings for publication. The three previously auditioned previews are unchanged.

levelRationale: Short past-tense statements, a purpose expressed with に, basic locations and familiar study words. It is a concrete account rather than an abstract explanation.

questions.explanation: 勉強しに gives the purpose of going: to study Japanese.

options.label: To study Japanese
options.rationale: The opening explicitly says 日本語を勉強しに.

options.label: To work at the library
options.rationale: The student goes there to study, not for a job.

options.label: To buy a notebook
options.rationale: A notebook is used there, but no purchase is mentioned.

options.label: To teach a class
options.rationale: The speaker describes personal study, not teaching.

questions.prompt: Why did the student go to the library?

questions.explanation: 二階 identifies the floor and 窓のそば the seating location.

options.label: Near the first-floor entrance
options.rationale: The account names the second floor and a window.

options.label: Outside the building
options.rationale: The student describes an indoor floor and window.

options.label: By a window on the second floor
options.rationale: The location is 二階の窓のそば.

options.label: Next to a third-floor cafe
options.rationale: Neither the third floor nor a cafe is mentioned.

questions.explanation: Distinguish the friend's arrival at four from going home at five.

options.label: At 4 p.m.
options.rationale: Four is when the friend arrived.

options.label: At 5 p.m.
options.rationale: The student says 五時に家に帰りました.

options.label: At 2 p.m.
options.rationale: Two occurs in the floor number, not the departure time.

questions.prompt: What time did the student go home?

title: A library visit

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: 今日の午後、日本語を勉強しに図書館へ行きました。家は少しうるさいですから、図書館で勉強するのが好きです。
turns.translation: This afternoon I went to the library to study Japanese. My home is a little noisy, so I like studying at the library.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: 二階の窓のそばに座りました。日本語の本を読んで、ノートに新しい言葉を書きました。
turns.translation: I sat by a window on the second floor. I read a Japanese book and wrote new words in my notebook.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: 四時に友達が来ました。一緒に少し話してから、五時に家に帰りました。
turns.translation: A friend came at four. After talking together for a little while, I went home at five.
